entries.unchanged_closure_criteria: Trace both directions and publish offset/fork validation and continuation fixtures, including fresh/resumed/completed and inconsistent state.
entries.review: Retained RFLT consumer/builder and upload handler/parser code, explicit byte grammar and validation limits, and 23 final native cases establish fresh, zero, inside, EOF, beyond-EOF and all-ones offsets; unknown/repeated fork entries; malformed magic/version/minimum-length no-reply windows; interrupted 13/5 partial state; negotiated offsets; exact continuation; missing/completed-file errors; and inconsistent-client appends. Paired host/guest packets and before/after HFS+ forks independently agree. Unchecked entry-count bounds are documented, not certified safe. Folder resume, disk-full, large-file and restart-durability requirements remain GAP-059/060/064.
